title: MCF3M Module 1 — Introduction to the Quadratic Function (first-slice owned bank)

process_slots.name: Explain function vs relation that is not a function using tables, graphs, mapping, equations, and strategies such as the vertical-line test
Substitute into and evaluate linear and quadratic functions in function notation, including application contexts
Describe domain and range of linear and quadratic functions from numeric, graphical, and algebraic representations
Explain restrictions on domain and range of a quadratic function in real-world contexts
Describe the roles of a, h, and k in f(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k as transformations of f(x) = x^2
Sketch g(x) = a(x − h)^2 + k by applying one or more transformations to the graph of f(x) = x^2
